title: Hancock Whitney Names Community Development Advisory Council Members
summary: Hancock Whitney named its Community Development Advisory Council to provide guidance and advice helping the bank recognize and develop new opportunities.
body_markdown:
### Team of top leaders to guide banks in creating more opportunities for underserved communities


Hancock Whitney –one of America’s strongest, safest banks—has named some of the Gulf South’s most accomplished and influential housing, small business, economic development, and media professionals to the bank’s Community Development Advisory Council. The 19-member council provides guidance and advice to help the bank recognize and develop new opportunities to further financial and economic health for individuals, businesses, communities, and other stakeholders.


“The Hancock Whitney Community Development Advisory Council comprises an energized group of business and community leaders who will play a key role in charting our region’s economic future,” said Hancock Whitney Ashley Aubrey Harrison, Senior Vice President and Director of Community & Economic Development. “Their deep knowledge of the challenges some of our community’s face for affordable housing, small businesses growth and economic stability will be invaluable to our ongoing efforts. Their expertise will help us understand how we can facilitate solutions that empower individuals, families, and businesses to build and protect a more secure financial future and a better quality of life.”
